options.name: content_json
options.description: The content of the JSON file to be imported. Mutually exclusive with I(content_xml) and I(content_yaml).

options.name: content_xml
options.description: The content of the XML file to be imported. Mutually exclusive with I(content_json) and I(content_yaml).

options.name: content_yaml
options.description: The content of the YAML file to be imported. Mutually exclusive with I(content_json) and I(content_xml).

options.name: rules
options.description: The rules for importing the configuration. Please refer to rules of the Zabbix configuration.import API documentation for more details. https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/current/en/manual/api/reference/configuration/import
